lines.en: By day I don't walk; I only sit.

lines.zh: 我的位置固定在展厅角落。
lines.en: My place is fixed in the hall's corner.

lines.zh: 我试着挪一点点，很勉强。
lines.en: I try to shift a little; it barely works.
I've sat like this for years.
My shadow on the wall doesn't move.
When the boards creak, it isn't me.
On the display stand, my head turns halfway.
My legs won't lift; I can only sit.

lines.zh: 我朝着过道那边偏了偏。
lines.en: I lean a little toward the aisle.
I sit and let the dust gather.
I can't change this posture.
I've been here from morning till night.
My joints have locked up.
I rock slightly on the chair.
I lean toward where people are.
My toes don't reach the floor.
I sit, eyes still lit.

lines.zh: 我是个展品，白天就该这样。
lines.en: I'm an exhibit; this is how it goes by day.
My head tilts to one side.

lines.zh: 我不动，游客会多看我几眼。
lines.en: Still, and visitors look longer.

lines.zh: 我的皮套在灯下显得更旧。
lines.en: In the light my suit looks older.
I wait for the night-shift bell.
I sit upright and stiff.
The light falls from the side.
I count the seams in the floor.

lines.zh: 这一刻，我只是一件旧物。
lines.en: In this moment, I'm only an old thing.
Dust settles in my missing ear.

lines.zh: 我听着展厅里的脚步声。
lines.en: I listen to footsteps in the hall.
On the display stand, I don't move.
My position has never changed.
I wait here for the dark.

lines.zh: 灰尘在我肩上积了薄薄一层。
lines.en: A thin layer of dust gathers on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 你从我这个角度看不到。
lines.en: You can't see from where I sit.
Sitting, I can only raise my eyes.
You're standing too near the exhibit.
Only half my face remains.
I watched you walk past the whole time.
My fingers rest on my knees.
You didn't notice me moving, did you?
Tell me, what time is it?

lines.zh: 我抬起头，很慢，铰链在响。
lines.en: I raise my head slowly; the hinge creaks.
There's a crack in the wall behind you.

lines.zh: 我这样坐着，看着不吓人。
lines.en: Sitting like this, I don't look frightening.
When you come near, my eyes move.
You strike something that only sits.
My suit split a little.
I sway and the chair rattles.
I can't dodge; I can only take it.
The frame inside is showing.

lines.zh: 白天的展示位，我坐着不动。
lines.en: By day I sit still on the display stand.
I've memorized all of this blow.
Dust settles over the damage.
I sit here, and I don't fall.
I can still watch you.

lines.zh: 你放在我面前的那东西？
lines.en: That thing you set before me?
I can't take it; my hands are too stiff.
Watching from here is enough.

lines.zh: 你可以把它放在我脚边。
lines.en: You can leave it at my feet.
I can't smell much.
I'll watch it until dark.
Call it your kindness; I'll remember.
If I could move, I'd take it.
Don't take it away; leave it here.
Watching like this is fine too.

lines.zh: 我想伸手，可是抬不起来。
lines.en: I want to reach, but can't lift my arm.
Hold it higher so I can see.
It glints under the lamp.

lines.zh: 我会一直记着这个位置。
lines.en: I'll remember this spot.
When you leave, it stays.
Taken. Thank you.

lines.zh: 我坐着，撞上来就像撞墙。
lines.en: Sitting, I feel like a wall.
Don't push the chair; I can't get up.
I don't give up this spot.
Your knee knocked against mine.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你也推不动。
lines.en: Still as I am, you can't push me.
There isn't much room here.
You bumped the display; careful.
Sitting, I can only make you go around.

lines.zh: 我的重量都压在椅子上。
lines.en: All my weight rests on the chair.
The bump echoes in the hall.

lines.zh: 另一只旧皮套坐我对面。
lines.en: Another worn suit sits across from me.
A whole aisle lies between us.
Only after dark can we move.
She too has only half a face.
We simply look at each other.

lines.zh: 灯光把我们的影子连起来。
lines.en: The light joins our shadows.
I tilt my head slightly; so does she.
The night is long; we're unhurried.
By day we become ornaments again.
I remember where she sits.
I can't reach the things on the floor.
I nudge it with my toe.
It rolled to my feet; convenient.
I bend slowly, barely.
I tuck it under the chair.
Only I can see this spot.
I can't lift a hand to pick it up.
It stays there; I keep watching.
Someone will come and collect it.
I remember where it fell.
I have no one to fight.
You want to fight? I can't stand.
I'm sitting here; don't push me.
I don't yield my spot.
You struck an exhibit.
I watch you without a word.
Wait for dark and you'll know.
I sit, not shifting a block.

lines.zh: 我坐了很多年，起身很勉强。
lines.en: I have sat for years; standing is an effort.
Very well, so be it.
By day I face only one way.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我都看得清。
lines.en: Every step you take, I see clearly.

lines.zh: 我坐着，可是眼睛跟着你。
lines.en: I sit, but my eyes follow you.
The lamps don't reach the corner.
I heard you touch the display.
I know the distance of every step.
Whoever's outside the glass, stop knocking.
I'm in no hurry; I sit.
I've been watching all along.
Soon; dark will make it right.
I can't reach; I can only glare.
I raise a hand, then it drops.
The chair creaks under me.
I lean forward, off balance.
Half my face has been taken off.
I can only reach your knee.

lines.zh: 我的手指擦过你的袖子。
lines.en: My fingers brush your sleeve.

lines.zh: 椅子腿在地上刮出声音。
lines.en: The chair legs scrape the floor.
I lunge, clumsily.

lines.zh: 你退开一步，我够不着了。
lines.en: You step back and I can't reach.
I've been sitting here since morning.
My name is written on the display.
By day I'm just an ornament.
The lights come on; I still sit.
I've never changed this position.
The visitors leave; I'm still here.
In the corner of the hall, I wait.
I sit still, as if forgotten.
This old face looks at the aisle.
Only when you come near do I look up.

lines.zh: 火在我身边烧，皮套开始焦。
lines.en: Fire burns beside me and my suit starts to scorch.

lines.zh: 椅子翻了，我跟着摔在地上。
lines.en: The chair tips and I fall with it.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的膝盖，我起不来。
lines.en: Water passes my knees and I can't rise.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从椅子上掀下来。
lines.en: The blast throws me off the chair.
An arrow pins the wall by my ear.

lines.zh: 这股光让我连眼都转不动。
lines.en: This light freezes even my eyes.

lines.zh: 我坐得太久，里面都凉了。
lines.en: Sitting so long, everything inside has cooled.

lines.zh: 雷打下来时，我整个人震了一下。
lines.en: When the bolt lands, my whole body jolts.
The chair is gone and I hang suspended.
